note: Gazette defines disability and commences parts of the Persons With Disability Act; it states nothing on access to information or digital services.

facts.fact: Assistant Minister Mabuse Pule said the government had provided special needs learners with assistive technologies including braille note takers, text magnifiers and auto acoustic devices for hearing impairment testing.
facts.system: assistive technologies for special needs learners

note: Only procurement awards to persons with disabilities' firms; nothing on digital accessibility.
